watch.summary: After conceding a goal and jokingly claiming 'it's all part of the plan,' the streamer immediately scores off the kickoff to tie the game.

beats.what: Opponent scores a goal against the streamer.
Streamer laughs it off and sarcastically claims 'it's all part of the plan'.
The ball goes straight into the opponent's net for an instant goal.
Streamer hypes himself up for predicting the outcome.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: When I say it's all part of the plan boys, I mean it!
watch.why: The comedy works through perfect timing and accidental triumph. Sarcastically covering up a mistake with 'it's all part of the plan' usually leads to further failure, but scoring instantly off kickoff makes the streamer look like an accidental mastermind.
